title: Amazon Echo Dot 4th-Generation smart speaker is smaller and rounder
description: The most prominent differences between the latest Amazon Echo Dot 4th-Generation smart speaker and earlier models are its small size and round shape. This smart speaker features an LED display that you tap to snooze or create a fuller sound..
